maria-cs: Morning team — quick async CS standup for AcmeFin (renewal Apr 5).
What I did: demoed SSO flow for security team, escalated latency/regression to eng (ticket #4529).
Blockers: SSO failing on Okta (403 after redirect), customer sees timeouts on long prompt runs, legal still needs updated EULA.
Today: get Okta metadata, run another demo Wed, push renewal paperwork.

ops-bot: Ticket #4529 set to highest priority and assigned to sam-eng.

sam-eng: on it. saw KV-cache eviction around 03:10 UTC — reproduced in staging. suspect hotspot on long-context sessions. gathering heap profiles.

maria-cs: pasted reduced logs:
```
2026-03-16T03:09:58Z ERROR handler: request-id=abc123 latency=2120ms kv_cache_evictions=18
2026-03-16T03:10:02Z WARN  model: slow-step: step=attn kernel=matmul_cuda
```

diego-ae: FYI AcmeFin execs asked for SLA numbers during renewal call; can we get 99.9% story?

sam-eng: I need the customer's session IDs to trace. @maria-cs can you share session IDs and the SSO redirect URL?

maria-cs: shared SSO metadata in DM and put session IDs here: sess-9f2, sess-9f3, sess-9f8. Redirect URL: https://acmefin.app/internal/sso/callback

luke-success: Blocking for renewal: customer adoption of audit logs. they've requested per-token usage breakdown. Product ok to expose via console by EOW?

julia-pm: Product can prioritize console report, but need a spec. @luke-success can you draft field list?

sam-eng: ETA for initial RCA: EOD today, will post repro and diff. If it's a kernel issue, might need a hotfix.

maria-cs: Thanks — I'll push timeline to AcmeFin and propose 48-72h for fix. If no fix, propose rollback to previous model version.

diego-ae: Also renewal negotiation note: offer 10% credit if we hit SLA improvements within 30 days.

maria-cs: noted. I'll include that in proposal.
